conventions.ratio: y/x as one correctly rounded division; null when x = 0 (undefined, not +-Infinity)
conventions.naive: atan(y/x) in (-pi/2, pi/2); null when the ratio is undefined
conventions.halfTurns: atan2 = atan + halfTurns*pi with halfTurns in {-1, 0, 1}; x>0: 0, x<0 and y>=0: +1, x<0 and y<0: -1; null when x = 0
conventions.placement: tip = tail + v and measured = tip - tail in exact decimal arithmetic rounded to 9 places

tolerance.rationale: y/x is one correctly rounded division in both languages (0 ulps). Math.atan and Math.atan2 need not be correctly rounded; the tolerance leaves headroom for other engines. Locations, halfTurns, null/undefined policies and placement sums must match EXACTLY.
